integrity: The critical generator and jerk identities were reconstructed directly from the vector field and replayed by an included dependency-free exact sparse-polynomial checker. The support, rigidity, sign-crossing, and Wirtinger arguments are analytic. The foundational 1994 article's substantive pages were inspected in full; later comparisons were inspected at full-page or statement level as specified in the review. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats compactly supported invariant probability measures and periodic trajectories of the generalized Sprott M family with a>0. It proves that b>0 is necessary for non-equilibrium compact recurrence but does not prove existence for every positive b, nor stability, entropy, mixing, basin size, or sharp attainability of the period infimum.
title: Compact-recurrence obstruction and strict period floor in the generalized Sprott M flow
